product_family: Crowdsourced AI/ML data-science tournament platform (numer.ai) where participants build models on obfuscated financial data to predict markets; feeds an affiliated hedge fund (Numerai Hedge Fund / Numerai GP LLC, numerai.fund) open only to accredited/institutional investors. Sub-products include Numerai Signals (external-data tournament) and Numerai Crypto. Participants stake the NMR cryptocurrency on submitted models.

privacy.ai_training_note: Numerai is not a generative-AI SaaS tool; it distributes obfuscated, regularized financial features to a global network of data scientists who submit their own predictive models. The homepage states the tournament data is 'Obfuscated, so it can be given out for free,' which limits exposure of raw financial/PII data by design. Numerai in turn aggregates participants' submitted predictions into a 'meta model' used by its hedge fund - this is the core, openly disclosed mechanic of the product, not a hidden LLM-training use of customer content. Whether participant-submitted model code/IP is used beyond scoring could not be confirmed; no explicit opt-out language was located.
privacy.data_region: Not publicly specified; no data-residency or regional-hosting information found on vendor domain.

security.name: API Authentication
security.value: Scoped API keys (public_id + secret_key pair) generated per-user under Account -> Custom API Keys; each key carries a configurable set of permission scopes rather than full-account access.

security.name: Data Obfuscation
security.value: Tournament training/prediction data is described as 'clean and regularized... Obfuscated, so it can be given out for free,' reducing exposure of raw source financial data to participants.

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Program
security.value: No SECURITY.md or public responsible-disclosure policy found across the Numerai GitHub organization's public repositories.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Not documented publicly; site and API are served over HTTPS, but no formal encryption-in-transit disclosure (e.g., TLS version, HSTS policy) was located.

products.name: Numerai Tournament
products.data_scope: Obfuscated, anonymized equity-market features and targets; no participant PII required beyond account/login credentials and API keys.
products.notes: Free to enter; participants submit model predictions and can stake NMR cryptocurrency on their models to earn or lose based on performance.

products.name: Numerai Signals
products.data_scope: Participant-sourced external datasets combined with Numerai targets.
products.notes: Variant tournament for data scientists who bring their own signals/data sources.

products.name: Numerai Crypto
products.notes: Crypto-asset focused tournament, same staking/reward mechanics.

products.name: Numerai Hedge Fund (Numerai GP LLC / numerai.fund)
products.data_scope: Likely handles investor KYC/financial/PII data as a regulated investment vehicle; this is not confirmed by public vendor pages.
products.notes: Separate legal entity from the free tournament platform; open only to institutional and qualifying accredited/high-net-worth investors, not retail users. Reported ~$450M AUM with a JPMorgan asset-management commitment (per independent press, not vendor-sourced).

compare.pricing_model: Free to participate in tournaments; earnings/losses paid in NMR cryptocurrency via staking. The affiliated hedge fund is a separate, investor-only financial product with its own (unverified) fee structure.

flags: No trust center, security page, or any SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA / GDPR-specific documentation could be found on numer.ai, docs.numer.ai, or the Numerai GitHub org, despite direct search and fetch attempts. Absence of evidence here is due to genuinely thin public disclosure, not a JS-rendering gap for the certification claims themselves.

Several unrelated companies share similar names, including Numero, NumberAI, Numerion Labs, Numerize AI, Numeric.io, and Norm Ai. This report covers numer.ai / Numerai Inc., the crowdsourced AI/ML tournament platform and its affiliated hedge fund.

Numerai spans two materially different entities: the free, low-PII tournament/API platform (numer.ai) and an affiliated, investor-only hedge fund (Numerai GP LLC / numerai.fund) that likely handles investor KYC/financial PII under separate and unverified data practices. Do not apply one compliance posture to both.

Vendor is an atypical fit for standard SaaS-style security review: it is fundamentally a hedge fund whose tournament data is intentionally obfuscated/anonymized by design, which reduces PII exposure but also means industry-standard SaaS trust signals (trust portal, DPA page, security whitepaper) are simply absent rather than hidden.
No evidence of a security incident or breach was found, but absence of negative news is not proof of a security program.
